title: Pure Vendread
summary: Vendread cards only, with generic Links and staples. Vendread is a Zombie Ritual deck that never runs out of tribute fodder. The small Vendreads revive themselves from the GY, and each one gives the Ritual Monster made from it an extra effect. Revendread Slayer and Vendread Battlelord search a Ritual Spell or Ritual Monster and mill a Vendread when they leave, and the Ritual Spells can banish Zombies from the GY as their cost. Vendread Battlelord stops a whole card type from activating for the turn, and Vendread Chimera negates destruction. The 2022 cards lead. Ravenous Vendread summons a Vendread face-down and Ritual Summons with it at once. Scar of the Vendread searches a Vendread Spell/Trap when it hits the GY. Vendread Scavenger revives itself next to Revendread Slayer.
